name: B10-0225/2026 (S&D) – Escalating trafficking and exploitation by criminal groups in Haiti
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on escalating trafficking and exploitation by criminal groups in Haiti
part_text:
**What it asks for**

This is not a law. It is the European Parliament stating its position and asking others to act. It condemns the violence and child trafficking by gangs in Haiti. It asks Haiti to protect children, punish those responsible and end impunity. It asks the European Union and its member states to give more money and support for child protection, justice, aid, and the new security force. It also asks countries to stop deporting people back to Haiti.

**Key points**

- The European Parliament is only stating a position; it does not change any law.
- It asks the EU to fund child protection, justice, aid and the new security force.
- It asks countries to stop deporting Haitians and to enforce the arms embargo.
